On this day you read Mughal architecture and historical centres of Kurukshetra.

Transport from Delhi, the start time, meals and pace are arranged with you, and the quotation states exactly what is included.

What it covers

  • Thanesar settlement intro
  • Sheikh Chilli tomb precinct
  • Associated heritage viewpoints
  • Museum option if open

How the time is spent

  1. Thanesar settlement intro 25 min

    Locate regional religious and courtly heritage.

    You: map

  2. Sheikh Chilli tomb precinct 50 min

    Read Mughal-era funerary architecture.

    You: elevation sketch

  3. Associated heritage viewpoints 50 min

    Compare building phases and art.

    You: find motifs

  4. Museum option if open 25 min

    Use gallery objects or printed plate pack.

    You: interpretation worksheet

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Situate Thanesar within its regional historical context.
  • Use observable topography and published evidence to test an interpretation.
  • Produce a concise field record with uncertainty clearly identified.

Where
Thanesar, Kurukshetra, Haryana
For
Individuals, families, schools and institutions
Length
About 2.5 hours at the site, plus travel from Delhi
When
Any day you choose. October to March is the most comfortable season.
Led by
A regional heritage researcher, with a local guide where needed
Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Starting point
Delhi, or wherever you are staying in the region.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water, a hat and sun protection. Much of the day is outdoors.
